item.title: Why Are We Involved in Cuba? Unravelling Tensions Between D.C. and Havana NEW — Thu Sep 17, 6:15 PM — Montclair Main - Conference Room
item.description:
This is a free Adult School class. Click here to register.
The troubled relationship between Cuba and the United States is like no other. Only 90 miles of water separate the two nations, but they have remained far apart politically, economically, and ideologically for more than 60 years.
In this class, we will explore the roots of the enmity between Cuba and the U.S., tracing the evolving landscape from the the initial rumblings of the Cuban Revolution in the 1950s, through the rise of Fidel Castro, the hardening of U.S. positions on Cuba's leadership, through the current confrontation as Washington clamps down on Cuba's economy. How did we get here? Why are we here? And where is all this going?
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.title: Hackensack River Cruise: Boating Through Bergen — Tue Sep 22, 2:00 PM — Montclair - Offsite
item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
Join us for a trip up the Hackensack River from the southern Meadowlands to heart of the city of Hackensack. Taking the route once traveled by the coastal schooners and steamers that carried cargo to and from Bergen County, we will pass the ruins of their former docks and landings and discuss the region’s all-but-forgotten maritime history. Before turning back, we will travel upriver to the Court Street Bridge and offer participants an opportunity to get an up-close view of the USS Ling, a World War II submarine that was sadly abandoned after Hurricane Sandy in 2012.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.description:

Join our celebration of the Chinese Mid-Autumn Moon Festival! The instructor will begin this class with a 45-minute talk about the holiday while she simultaneously creates a brush painting of Chang'e, the Moon Goddess who drank an immortality potion and floated up to live in the sky. After a 15-minute break, students will have 90 minutes for a hands-on workshop on brush-painting chrysanthemums, a classic symbol of fall in China. The Folklife Center of Northern NJ will also provide traditional mooncake cookies and chrysanthemum tea for participants to sample.
Co-sponsored by the Folklife Center of Northern NJ.

item.title: Wine Confidence 101 — Wed Sep 23, 6:00 PM — Montclair - Cornerstone Montclair
item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
Build your wine confidence in just four weeks. Whether you are new to wine or already a connoisseur, this approachable course will give you the knowledge, tasting skills, and vocabulary to enjoy wine more fully—and choose it more confidently.
Throughout this 4-week course, you will explore the world’s primary grape varieties and discover the many styles of white, rosé, red, and sparkling wines. We will break down the basics of viticulture and winemaking so you can understand how grapes, regions, and production choices shape the flavors, aromas, body, and texture in every glass. You will also learn what makes the major wine-producing countries distinctive and how to recognize key differences among grape varieties and wine styles.
Each session includes guided tasting practice, from visual assessment through aroma, flavor, structure, and finish, helping you evaluate wine and learn why you like or dislike different wines. Durin

item.title: Parent Academy - September: Starting Strong: Helping Your Child Thrive This School Year — Wed Sep 23, 6:30 PM — Virtual
item.description:
The beginning of a new school year is filled with excitement, change, and new opportunities—but it can also bring stress and uncertainty for both children and parents. This interactive presentation provides caregivers with practical, research-informed strategies to help children build confidence, establish healthy routines, manage stress, strengthen relationships, and succeed academically throughout the school year. Parents will leave with actionable tools they can begin using the very next day, regardless of their child’s age.
Source: MHA of Essex and Morris

item.title: CEDAR GROVE PARK WALK — Fri Sep 25, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Let's Walk!! You can **park** in the **Robert J. O'Toole Community Center** parking lot located at **199 Fairview Ave, Cedar Grove, NJ 07009**
**Meet us under the gazebos** at the park directly across the street.
We will be walking the paved walking path that meanders over foot bridges and past little “workout stations.”
We will walk about 3 - 4 miles. There are options to break off from the walk if you need to.
Bathrooms are available.
Cedar Grove Park is the newest addition to the Essex County Park System, formally dedicated on December 12, 2016. At 77 acres, it is the fourth largest park in the county parks system. The park features the Robert J. O'Toole Community Center, four bocce courts, a farm themed playground area and three fitness stations along meandering walking paths.
Rain or extreme weather will cancel the event.
PLEASE ARRIVE 5 MINUTES PRIOR TO START TIME.
Disclaimer: If you join us for a hike, please understand that you are responsible for your own preparedness
